issues: Wires a native [services.clickhouse] block — rubric explicitly defers ClickHouse to Docker via `make clickhouse` (fd-ulimit 262144 + config.d mount make the native service unreliable); nowhere documents the Docker path
Hallucinated ClickHouse version: pins clickhouse.version = "25.11.2.24-stable"; catalog has 26.6.1.1193-stable
Hallucinated Elixir package: installs elixir_1_19; catalog max is elixir@1.18.4 (which satisfies mix.exs ~> 1.18 and bundles OTP 28)
Hand-rolls a full ClickHouse config.xml/users.xml in the hook — large unverifiable surface the golden deliberately avoids
Adds unrequested minio + minio-client services and gcc/brotli, expanding scope well past the repo's documented dev flow
mix deps.get is gated behind an `[ mix.lock -nt deps ]` test that is a broken string comparison inside `[ ]`, so deps refresh silently never fires
postgres service depends on PGDATA/PGPORT/PGHOST from [vars]/hook rather than being self-contained like the golden's explicit $FLOX_ENV_CACHE path
Speculative pkg-group splits (nodejs, clickhouse) justified by invented claims about catalog pages

results.manifest_excerpt:
schema-version = "1.13.0"
# Generated by /floxify

[install]
# Erlang/OTP 28 is bundled with the elixir package — no separate erlang needed.
elixir_1_19.pkg-path = "elixir_1_19"
# nodejs 23 is EOL upstream and does not share a catalog page with the rest —
# isolated in its own group so the project's pinned major still resolves.
nodejs_23.pkg-path = "nodejs_23"
nodejs_23.pkg-group = "nodejs"
postgresql_18.pkg-path = "postgresql_18"
# Pinned to the 25.11 line the project runs in CI and prod; needs its own group.
clickhouse.pkg-path = "clickhouse"
clickhouse.version = "25.11.2.24-stable"
clickhouse.pkg-group = "clickhouse"
minio.pkg-path = "minio"
minio-client.pkg-path = "minio-client"
gcc.pkg-path = "gcc"
gnumake.pkg-path = "gnumake"
brotli.pkg-path = "brotli"

[vars]
# The app loads config/.env.dev itself (Envy, config/runtime.exs) — these vars
# only make the endpoints those URLs already point at actually serve.
# DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/plausible_dev
PGHOST = "127.0.0.1"
PGPORT = "5432"
PGUSER = "postgres"
PGDATABASE = "plausible_dev"
# CLICKHOUSE_DATABASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8123/plausible_events_db
CLICKHOUSE_HTTP_PORT = "8123"
CLICKHOUSE_TCP_PORT = "9000"
# S3_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:10000, S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID/SECRET=minioadmin
MINIO_ROOT_USER = "minioadmin"
MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD = "minioadmin"
MINIO_API_PORT = "10000"
MINIO_CONSOLE_PORT = "10001"

[hook]
on-activate = '''
  cd "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT"

  # --- Elixir / Hex caches -------------------------------------------
  export MIX_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/mix"
  export HEX_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/hex"
  export MC_CONFIG_DIR="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/mc"
  mkdir -p "$MIX_HOME" "$HEX_HOME" "$MC_CONFIG_DIR"
  mix local.hex --force --if-missing >&2
  mix local.rebar --force --if-missing >&2

  # --- PostgreSQL cluster (replaces: make postgres) -------------------
  export PGDATA="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/postgres"
  if [ ! -d "$PGDATA" ]; then
    initdb -D "$PGDATA" \
      --username="$PGUSER" \
      --auth=trust \
      --no-locale \
      --encoding=UTF8 >&2
    pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" -o "-p $PGPORT -k /tmp" -l "$PGDATA/init.log" start >&2
    until pg_isready -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" -q; do sleep 0.2; done
    createdb -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" -U "$PGUSER" plausible_dev
    createdb -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" -U "$PGUSER" plausible_test
    pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" stop -m fast >&2
  fi

  # --- ClickHouse config (replaces: make clickhouse) ------------------
  # Stock server config with paths relocated under the Flox cache. The repo's
  # .clickhouse_config mount is an empty optional overlay, and the container
  # runs with CLICKHOUSE_SKIP_USER_SETUP=1 — i.e. default user, no password.
  export CLICKHOUSE_DIR="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/clickhouse"
  mkdir -p "$CLICKHOUSE_DIR"/{data,tmp,user_files,access,logs}
  cat > "$CLICKHOUSE_DIR/config.xml" <<XML
<clickhouse>
  <logger>
    <level>warning</level>
    <log>$CLICKHOUSE_DIR/logs/server.log</log>
    <errorlog>$CLICKHOUSE_DIR/logs/server.err.log<
